en.title: An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models
en.hook: Analyze what certified code models can reliably know and where their errors lie beyond the visibility of sampling gates.
key_takeaways: Characterizes model errors within and beyond sampling gate visibility
Explores theoretical limits and guarantees of certified code world models
Examines the mathematical implications of enclosed modes as gauge choices
